logging._description: Logging configuration for ipcamd — application, access, security, audit, and remote syslog

access._description: HTTP API access log — records every API request with client IP, method, URI, status, timing

security._description: Security event log — login/logout, auth failures, lockouts, brute-force, unauthorized access

audit._description: Audit trail — configuration changes, system actions, who changed what and when

syslog._description: Remote syslog forwarding (RFC 5424) — send security/audit events to a central log server

system_logger._description: Periodic system data collection — replaces external shell logger. All sources and destinations are API-controllable.

kernel._description: Kernel ring buffer (dmesg) — captures new kernel messages since last collection

thermal._description: SoC temperature from thermal_zone0 — timestamped temperature readings

sysdiag._description: System diagnostics — uptime, load, CPU, memory, disk, network, process count

app_mirror._description: Application log mirror — periodic snapshot of ipcamd.log to SD/flash

sd_card._description: SD card log storage — date-stamped files, retention by age and total size

flash._description: Internal flash log storage — rotating files with size limits
